parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of module versions to display per page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的模块版本数量。数量限制：每页最多可显示200条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device that you want to query.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询设备的名称。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying results. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1
parameters.name: current_page
